blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine unemployment rose to 5.4 percent in September from 5.3 percent in August, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) said on Friday. The latest reading was nearly flat month on month but marked another increase after unemployment eased in August for the first time following three straight months of increases. READ: Labor market to recover in fourth quarter, says Balisacan The latest print put the number of jobless Filipinos at 2.86 million, up from 2.77 million in the previous month.
